question: Are exact regex compatibility, uncommon formats and relative performance equivalent to the original?
probes: If requested later, run shared large real-world datasets through both applications; compare exact result sets and timings.
resolution: 22 deterministic filesystem assertions pass and own 2500-file content search took 689 ms with warm cache/24 logical processors. rebuild_check passes build and screenshot; it explicitly says mechanics runtime comparison cannot be resolved by another builder turn. .NET regex replaces the original Boost engine; exact dialect compatibility and relative speed are not established. Supported formats and exclusions are documented in the guide and MECHANICS.md. No claim of full equivalence is made.
